name: Heimerdinger
notes: Heimerdinger auto-attacks normally (ranged, windup 0.2) whenever no cast is due; his kit adds no on-hit or attack-speed effect of its own, so this only fills the gaps between casts.

Casts go one after another: Q, W and E each have a 0.25 s cast time (the dossier's castTime for all three) during which no other cast starts and no attack begins; one busy_until tracks this. UPGRADE!!! itself has no cast time and is a toggle that does not count as an ability activation, so it costs nothing and delays nothing.

UPGRADE!!! is toggled once at t=0 (instant, no on-cast procs) and its empowerment is spent on the very next Hextech Micro-Rockets cast, turning it into Hextech Rocket Swarm; UPGRADE!!!'s own cooldown (70-100s) is far longer than the fight so it is never toggled again, and Q and E are left in their base forms since Rocket Swarm returns far more damage than upgrading either of those for a single use.

The opening sequence is therefore: R toggled instantly at t=0, then whichever of Q (deploy a turret) and the W/E events is earliest is cast first (the engine casts Q before any tied event), each taking its 0.25 s cast time in turn, so the fight's early casts land in sequence rather than all at t=0.

All 3 Turret Kit charges are assumed already banked at the start of the fight (an established level-16 Heimerdinger plausibly has them); H-28G Evolution Turret is deployed (0.25 s cast time each) on Q's own 1s cooldown until 3 turrets are up, after which Q is never cast again.

H-28G Evolution Turret 'lasts until destroyed' and the dummy never fights back, so once 3 turrets are deployed they persist for the whole fight; no turret redeploy or duration logic is modeled beyond that.

The turret's beam only charges from Hextech Micro-Rockets hits (20% per rocket, both in normal and Rocket Swarm form) and from CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade hits (100%): the sources give no passive charge rate, so no passive charging is assumed, and every point of charge past 100% immediately fires one beam per active turret.

The turret's own rapid-fire attack interval is not stated anywhere in the sources; a 1-second tick per active turret is assumed as a representative 'rapid-fire' cadence (see assumed). This tick is the turret pet acting on its own, not a Heimerdinger cast, so it is not gated by his busy_until.

All 5 Hextech Micro-Rockets (and all 20 rockets of Rocket Swarm) are assumed to converge on the single stationary dummy, taking the full graduated-damage sequence (initial + reduced subsequent hits) each cast.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here reliably runs out of mana inside a short fight given the assumed cast cadence.
Hextech Affinity's movement speed near turrets is irrelevant to a stationary dummy fight and is not used by the driver.

assumed.why: no turret basic-attack interval is given by any source; assumed a 1s rapid-fire tick as a representative cadence
assumed all 3 turret kit charges are already banked at the fight's start rather than waiting on the ~20s recharge, plausible for an established level-16 Heimerdinger
